headline: HuyenBao v11.34 — quy ước màu nút: Bận=cam · Đang tiến hành=xanh · Bỏ/Huỷ=đỏ
summary: BUTTON COLOR CONVENTION. The whole app now follows one visual language: orange (.busy) for slot-taken / processing / 'đang bận' states, green (.ongoing) for actively-in-progress / 'đang học' states, and red (.danger) for discard / cancel / withdraw / leave / rehome actions. New CSS classes .busy (amber, theme-aware) and .ongoing (sage) join the existing .danger; the disabled grey is shared so a disabled busy/cancel button still reads as 'not now'. The license + short-course enrol buttons now colour themselves dynamically — green while you're studying, orange when the slot is full. The 'Drop study slot', 'Withdraw from market', 'Leave club', 'Rehome pet' buttons plus both modal cancel controls (✕ header + 'Hủy' footer in PurchaseConfirm) flipped from neutral grey ghost to red danger so the destructive intent is unmistakable at a glance.
features: BUTTON CONVENTION: busy = orange (.busy), in-progress = green (.ongoing), discard/cancel = red (.danger)
NEW CSS classes .busy (amber, light #c2680a / dark #e89446) and .ongoing (sage) — theme-aware, share the disabled grey
ENROL buttons (license + short course) now colour themselves: green while studying, orange when slots are full
DISCARD BUTTONS TURNED RED: Drop study slot · Withdraw from market · Leave club · Rehome pet · modal ✕ · modal 'Hủy'
